gaps: The available library case only creates a decimal Nos quantity and checks for no 5xx; it does not verify HTTP 200 specifically, reservation 2.5, or that the PR open quantity drops by 2.5.
The available vocabulary cannot express a QA draft with a controlled Nos line or read back reservation/open quantity.
